description: Membership log (spec §3.5, §4). devices: secrets and records used. chains: verifying `events` with `options` (trusted_anchor, witnessed_checkpoint) MUST yield `expected_state` exactly. invalid: verification MUST fail with expect_error. wrap_checks: validate `wraps` against the final state of chain `chain` (options.key_epoch null = any retained epoch 1..key_epoch); positives also give wraps_digest = b64 sha256(cjson(wraps sorted by rcpt)). sas: transcript, 6-digit code and digest for `input`.
